problems.text: Bifrost runs 2.3.1, three minor releases behind upstream 2.6.0.
The 2.3.1 to 2.6.0 store migrations are one-way, so a failed upgrade has no way back without a dump.
The pin test and the component page name 2.3.1, so a moved pin fails the gate and leaves the docs wrong.

goals.text: Run the current upstream Bifrost with every caller's traffic still working.
Keep a way back if the one-way store migrations go wrong.

outcomes.change: Job bifrost runs on v2.6.0 and every caller still works
outcomes.checked_by: `scripts/bifrost_smoke.py` against the new gateway, a bare-string rerank through the OpenViking key, a Gemini chat call, and a second `terraform plan` with no `bifrost_virtual_key` change

outcomes.change: A dump of the bifrost store, taken before the apply, sits at a name no job overwrites
outcomes.checked_by: the dump's object listed in the backup bucket and its path recorded in the component page

outcomes.change: The pin test and the component page name 2.6.0
